div.head: Rect 6
div.ab: [6] Gafolswane. Gafolswane gebyreð, þæt he sylle his slyht, be ðam ðe on lande stent.
Gafolspane (id est ad censum porcario) pertinet, ut suam occisionem det, secundum quod in patria statutum est.
GAFOL SwaNE . Gafolswane gebyreð þæt he sylle his slyht be ðam ðe on lande stent.
Gafolswane Gafolswane gebyreð þæt he sylle his slyht, be ðam ðe on lande stent.
Tenant swineherd It befits the tenant swineherd that he give his animals for slaughter according to [the custom] that stands on the estate.
Tenant Swineherd It is appropriate that the tenant swineherd give his animals for slaughter, according to the practices observed on the estate.

Zins[bäuerlicher] Schweinehirt. Dem zins[bäuerlichen] Schweinehirten [dem persönlich freien Pächter der Herrschaftsherde, im Gegensatz zu 7] kommt zu, dass er sein Schlachtvieh liefere nach dem [Verhältniss], das auf dem Landgute gilt.

The rent-paying swineherd. It is due from the rent-paying swineherd [the personally free tenant of the lord's herd, as opposed to 7] that he deliver his slaughter-pigs according to [the proportion] that holds on the estate.
div.note: Leo and Schmid translate the heading as ‘Be gafolswane’ following 7; but the rubricator repeats only the first word of the chapter; perhaps it served him, already Middle English, as a nominative too (compare ‘fife’ II Cn 30.3a). Liebermann compares Rect 2.
